central_claim: At least two recruiting interventional trials (NCT05918640, NCT06571734) admit patients with extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma through molecular eligibility criteria while never listing the histology in their registry conditions field, so a histology-based condition search does not find them, and the naive fix of a keyword map would also carry two adjudicated false positives that will refuse the patient -- so eligibility text must be read one trial at a time.

p1s.summary: Section 2's claim that 'five of them [twelve lost records] recoverable from another payload in the same file' cannot be verified from the committed artifact alone -- the JSON records which payload/query lost or silently damaged which NCT id, but does not itself carry a second, intact copy of any of the twelve to point to as the recovery source. The count of 12 lost records is exactly reproducible from transport_integrity.silently_damaged_records + unparseable_records (verified: 12 unique NCT ids), but the 'five recoverable' sub-claim rests on information (a clean duplicate payload) that is not present in research/literature/fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json as committed.
p1s.evidence: research/literature/fet-fusion-trial-eligibility-2026-08-07.json -> transport_integrity.silently_damaged_records (NCT05836571, NCT01189253, NCT04094610) and .unparseable_records (payloads ct_nct02180867_arst1321, ct_emc_all, ct_ewsr1_term, ct_myxoid_chondrosarcoma, ct_sarcoma_2026_new, covering NCT02180867, NCT00720174, NCT05355753, NCT07695311, NCT07188532, NCT05275426, NCT02736565, NCT01189253, NCT05697874, NCT06094101) union to exactly 12 unique NCT ids, matching the paper's count precisely. No field in the file names which 5 of the 12 have a surviving duplicate elsewhere, so a reader auditing the artifact cannot independently confirm that sub-clause.
p1s.fix: Either cite the specific payload slug/field that recovers each of the five, or soften to 'at least some were recoverable' if the exact five cannot be enumerated from the committed record.
